purpose: Classify finite-field failure modes by same-form integer transport before any new experiment.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: mu(F)=0 exactly when F has a repeated irreducible factor; equivalently gcd(F,F') != 1.
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: Repeated roots make discriminant zero and remove the polynomial from squarefree Mobius parity statistics.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: mu(n)=0 exactly when n has a repeated prime factor.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: Transport is exact but classical; previous squarefree/local controls already absorbed it.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Keep as a mandatory local control, never as a breakthrough signal.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: A polynomial tuple is locally inadmissible when some low-degree irreducible divides every shifted member in the local pattern.
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: Irreducible-pair and tuple counts vanish or distort before local obstruction removal.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: Prime tuples are blocked when a residue class modulo p forces divisibility for every candidate.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: Transport is exact at the local-obstruction level, but it is the classical admissibility/singular-series object already controlled in prior cycles.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Keep as required baseline subtraction for any future tuple statistic.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: For odd q and squarefree F, polynomial Mobius parity is (-1)^deg(F) times the quadratic character of Disc(F).
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: Coefficient-space discriminant square classes create exact Mobius parity structure.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: No integer coefficient-space discriminant character determines mu(n) or primality.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: The exact finite-field mechanism depends on coefficient-space geometry with no same-form integer object.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Use in novelty audits to reject coefficient-neighborhood Mobius claims over Z.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: In characteristic 2, Berlekamp/Artin-Schreier trace data replaces the quadratic discriminant character for Mobius parity mechanisms.
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: Characteristic-2 trace parity creates q=2-specific Mobius behavior.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: No integer Artin-Schreier trace-parity analogue exists.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: Characteristic-2 algebra is not a transport map to integer primes.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Treat q=2-only behavior as a warning flag unless an independent integer obstruction is named.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: Very-short-interval theorems require generic/Morse coefficient-space conditions; non-generic centers can violate the generic correlation law.
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: A polynomial center can be exceptional because its coefficient-line family has bad critical-value geometry.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: Integer short intervals do not have a coefficient-line Morse condition with the same logical form.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: The obstruction is tied to coefficient-space families, not an integer-local obstruction.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Use as a negative-control catalog for future finite-field experiments.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: Some finite-field polynomial-prime-value analogues fail from global Mobius/residue-theorem obstructions.
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: A theorem-side obstruction exists even when the naive classical analogue would predict no obstruction.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: No known classical integer obstruction has the same residue-theorem form.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: The obstruction argues against transport instead of producing a Z statistic.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Use as a veto class for finite-field-only discoveries.

obstructionClasses.finiteFieldIdentity: Complete monic degree shells can have exact Mobius/Liouville cancellations caused by the rational zeta function of F_q[t].
obstructionClasses.finiteFieldFailureMode: Complete-family averaging produces exact finite-field identities with no sampled integer counterpart.
obstructionClasses.integerSameForm: Integer partial sums over n<=X are not complete finite coefficient shells.
obstructionClasses.eligibilityReason: The exact cancellation is a calibration identity, not an integer-prime experiment.
obstructionClasses.nextUse: Use to test finite-field table correctness and to block complete-family overinterpretation.
